title_sq: SHESIM APARTAMENT 1+1 TE + FOREST RESIDENCE, SHKOZE (UNAZA LINDORE )
description_sq:
+Forest Residencë është një kompleks i paqtë në periferi të Tiranës me parkim te dedikuar dhe hapesira te perbashketa.perbehet nga 255 apartamente me shumellojshmeri tipologjishe: ne kat ndodhen vetem 3-4 apartamente per te ofruar intimitet dhe komoditet te banoreve. Për më shumë detaje më kontaktoni !
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 1+1 TE + FOREST RESIDENCE, SKOZE (EASTERN RING)
description_en: +Forest Residence is a quiet complex on the outskirts of Tirana with dedicated parking and common spaces. It consists of 255 apartments with typological diversity: there are only 3-4 apartments on the floor to offer privacy and comfort to the residents. All apartments have loggia balconies. It consists of an 8-story terraced building and 2 underground parking floors. In one of the buildings we have a 1+1 apartment with a private bathroom. total 86m2. It is located on the sixth residential floor. Floor plan in attached photos. For more details, contact me!
